codeReview.summary: The mobile day view was successfully rewritten using NativeWind v5. The implementation correctly adds a 24-hour timeline with 60px hour cells, a 52px time column, and properly styled event cards with dark mode support. HitSlop was elegantly utilized to ensure effective >44pt touch targets on the 15pt quarter-hour cells. No hardcoded colors or StyleSheet.create remain.

issues.description: The fallback class `bg-event-default/35` is used when no color is provided. This may not map to a valid Tailwind token in global.css if `--color-event-default` is undefined.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The commands.test definition in services.yaml uses `&&` which is not universally supported in older PowerShell versions on Windows, causing the worker to manually split the commands.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Worker's skillFeedback.deviations: 'The manifest chain uses &&, which is not supported by this shell version; splitting preserved the same validation intent'

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker instructions or implicit knowledge suggest using `jq`, which is not available in this Windows environment, prompting a fallback to Python.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Worker's skillFeedback.deviations: 'Used a Python one-liner to filter milestone features... jq is not installed in this environment'
